notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached or run, and the upstream sim backend gymnasium.make(Env01-v1) was not run because mujoco and gymnasium are not importable where the gate runs. Only Env01-v1 is served; Env02-v1 through Env05-v1 (the card's other entry symbols) are not bound by this package. The fake backend (fake.py) is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in for Env01: it returns the full fifteen-number observation and the six-element Box action space, but its joint increments, forward kinematics and reward are stand-ins, it uses six representative rows of the clone's 36 VALID_START_POSITIONS, and it was never compared with the upstream MuJoCo model. Determinism is published as statistical because the upstream reset_model draws from numpy's global generator (env01_v1.py:45-55), which reset(seed=...) does not seed; the fake's seeded repeatability is test data, not an upstream claim. The 32 ms timestep is frame_skip 16 (env_base_01.py:45) times MuJoCo's default 0.002 s; the scene leaves the option timestep commented out (env01.xml:3) and the upstream path was not measured. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for 'reset' and 'observation_space' (both inherited from the external gymnasium MujocoEnv base, which G7 cannot follow); four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, action.values[*], ticks). No G4 warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
